prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production equipment item icons (signet seal medallions, a swordswoman's personal relic) for a dark fantasy 2D action RPG. Image1 is the existing equipment sheet of this game: match its finely detailed pixel-illustrated painterly style, dark outlines, lighting and scale. Create ONE transparent RGBA square image with exactly FOUR separate items in an invisible 3 columns x 2 rows grid, filled left to right, top row first, and the remaining cells (bottom-right) left completely EMPTY. Each item centered in its own cell with wide transparent margins, never touching each other or the canvas edge, each item compact and filling about 60% of its cell: (1) HIGH grade seal: three ghostly afterimage sword silhouettes, (2) HIGH grade seal: a judge's branding sigil with scales and a downward blade, (3) HIGH grade seal: a beating golden heart with radiating pulse rings, (4) NOT a whole seal: a single broken jagged fragment of a gold-and-crimson seal medallion with a faint glow (crafting material). Each item is a single round or shield-shaped medallion, clearly readable at small icon size and clearly distinct from the others. Actual alpha transparency, no background, no floor, no shadow, no text, no labels, no characters.
